trailhead.label: Lago di Carezza (Karersee) car park, the board’s start

cautions: Busy around the lake in summer: keep your dog close and outside the lake fence.
About 12% on tarred lanes near the lake and the hut: watch for local traffic.
The Stadlalm has a playground and farm animals: dogs may not enter the playground, and keep your dog away from the animals.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
